tv_fs_two_ways.text: There's a slow way to say a word, and a fast way.
tv_fs_two_ways.heard: There's a slow way to say a word and a fast way.

tv_fs_tortoise.text: The tortoise says a word slowly, one sound at a time.
tv_fs_tortoise.heard: The tortoise says a word slowly, one sound at a time.

tv_fs_gaps.text: The slow way has little gaps between the sounds.
tv_fs_gaps.heard: The slow way has little gaps between the sounds.

tv_fs_rabbit.text: The rabbit pushes the sounds together, and says the word fast.
tv_fs_rabbit.heard: The rabbit pushes the sounds together and says the word fast.

tv_fs_read.text: When we read, we say the sounds first, then the word.
tv_fs_read.heard: When we read, we say the sounds first, then the word.

tv_fs_same.text: The tortoise and the rabbit say the very same word.
tv_fs_same.heard: The tortoise and the rabbit say the very same word.

tv_fs_made.text: Every word is made of sounds, one after another.
tv_fs_made.heard: Every word is made of sounds, one after another.

tv_fs_ninja.text: Slow first, then fast. That's how ninjas read words.
tv_fs_ninja.heard: Slow first, then fast. That's how ninjas read words.

tv_fs_mantra.text: We say the sounds slowly. Then we read the word fast.
tv_fs_mantra.heard: We say the sounds slowly, then we read the word fast.

tv_fs_spell.text: To build a word, we say it slowly first.
tv_fs_spell.heard: To build a word, we say it slowly first.

tv_fs_find.text: Saying it slowly helps us find every sound.
tv_fs_find.heard: Saying it slowly helps us find every sound.

tv_fs_hiding.text: There's a fast word hiding in every slow word.
tv_fs_hiding.heard: There's a fast word hiding in every slow word.

tv_fs_whole.text: The rabbit says the whole word, all at once.
tv_fs_whole.heard: The rabbit says the whole word all at once.

tv_fs_push.text: We push the sounds together to make the word.
tv_fs_push.heard: We push the sounds together to make the word.

tv_fs_turn.text: The slow way gives every sound a turn.
tv_fs_turn.heard: The slow way gives every sound a turn.

tv_fs_ninjas_can.text: Ninjas can say a word slowly, and fast too.
tv_fs_ninjas_can.heard: Ninjas can say a word slowly and fast too.

tv_fs_next.text: Saying it slowly tells us which sound comes next.
tv_fs_next.heard: Saying it slowly tells us which sound comes next.

tv_fs_start_end.text: The slow way shows us where each sound goes.
tv_fs_start_end.heard: The slow way shows us where each sound goes.

tv_fs_count.text: The slow way helps us count the sounds.
tv_fs_count.heard: The slow way helps us count the sounds.

tv_fs_say_sounds_slow.text: Let's say the sounds, the slow way...
tv_fs_say_sounds_slow.heard: Let's say the sounds the slow way.

tv_fs_rabbit_read.text: Now tap the rabbit, and read the word fast.
tv_fs_rabbit_read.heard: Now tap the rabbit and read the word fast.

tv_fs_say_slow.text: Let's say it the slow way...
tv_fs_say_slow.heard: Let's say it the slow way.

tv_fs_slow_tortoise.text: First the slow way, like the tortoise...
tv_fs_slow_tortoise.heard: First, the slow way, like the tortoise.

tv_fs_fast_rabbit.text: Now the fast way, like the rabbit...
tv_fs_fast_rabbit.heard: Now, the fast way, like the rabbit.

tv_fs_run.text: I'll say it the slow way. You catch the whole word.
tv_fs_run.heard: I'll say it the slow way. You catch the whole word.

tv_fs_stuck_slow.text: Let's say it the slow way first...
tv_fs_stuck_slow.heard: Let's say it the slow way first.

tv_fs_stuck_again.text: Here's the slow way again, one sound at a time...
tv_fs_stuck_again.heard: Here's the slow way again, one sound at a time.

tv_fs_stuck_push.text: Say the sounds with me. Then push them together, fast.
tv_fs_stuck_push.heard: Say the sounds with me, then push them together fast.

tv_fs_praise_both.text: Slow, then fast. That's real reading!
tv_fs_praise_both.heard: Slow, then fast. That's real reading.

tv_fs_praise_found.text: You heard the slow way, and found the word.
tv_fs_praise_found.heard: You heard the slow way and found the word.

tv_fs_praise_every.text: You said it slowly, and found every sound.
tv_fs_praise_every.heard: You said it slowly and found every sound.

tv_fs_praise_both_2.text: You said each sound slowly, then read the whole word.
tv_fs_praise_both_2.heard: You said each sound slowly, then read the whole word.

tv_fs_praise_both_3.text: The slow way, then the fast way. You read it!
tv_fs_praise_both_3.heard: The slow way, then the fast way. You read it.

tv_fs_praise_found_2.text: You pushed the sounds together, and heard the word.
tv_fs_praise_found_2.heard: You pushed the sounds together and heard the word.

tv_fs_praise_found_3.text: Those little sounds made a word, and you found it!
tv_fs_praise_found_3.heard: Those little sounds made a word and you found it.

tv_fs_praise_found_4.text: You listened to every sound, and caught the word!
tv_fs_praise_found_4.heard: You listened to every sound and caught the word.

tv_fs_praise_every_2.text: Slowly does it! Every sound is in its place.
tv_fs_praise_every_2.heard: Slowly does it, every sound is in its place.

tv_fs_praise_every_3.text: Sound by sound, the slow way. Well built!
tv_fs_praise_every_3.heard: Sound by sound, the slow way, well built.

tv_fs_praise_every_4.text: You listened slowly, and got the sounds in order.
tv_fs_praise_every_4.heard: You listened slowly and got the sounds in order.
